counting_rule: One original explicit review/rationale question workflow; scope, latest events and rendering are acceptance variants, not distinct deliverables.
syntax: Four Rust sources and Python verifier parse; no Cargo run

review.external: Retained trusted host CodeRabbit auth false; no external review/login.
review.parent: Existing typed decision reader provides bounded path relevance, latest events and raw record hashes. Low-authority context bypasses generic snippet clipping; explicit review requests cannot become answered approval claims. Ordinary and revision-pinned paths do not run this reader. Existing Core dependency already includes get_review_decisions.

temporary_resources.retention: Retain contract/verifier/wire/receipts until delivery accounting; new fixtures close application/database/Git handles before TempDir removal. No preexisting deletion.

next_action: Freeze the existing shipping checkout with the three source outcomes and one seven-case integration target. Verify bindings and run only focused combined native/public acceptance; minimum three is an admission floor, not release-by-count.
